advice: Abstain. The prior TRANS_B fast path is already measured and rejected: it won 3/10 paired runs and did not meet the adoption gate. The supplied evidence does not establish another distinct, legal, useful n=512 fast-path experiment. Keep the unchanged NN path and general fallback.
risks: Correctness evidence for the prior path does not establish a speedup. Do not repeat or rename it. Any future proposal needs a distinct source change and hypothesis, with all conversion and allocation timed, and must preserve the fixed benchmark and pass fast-path, fallback, tail, and n<=0 checks before ten-run paired evaluation.
